newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM plans new Zaragoza freighter service.
newsitem.headline: KLM plans new Zaragoza freighter service.

text.p: KLM Cargo is planning to introduce a Zaragoza freighter service following the French government's ban of weekend trucking traffic, said the airline.
The service is due to start on February 8.

Until now, the carrier has only had trucking services to its Spanish cargo sub-hub. KLM Cargo will use this new freighter link to serve the Spanish and Portuguese markets, the carrier said in a statement.
KLM Cargo's ex-Amsterdam flight to Zaragoza will depart on Saturdays and the inbound flight is scheduled for Sundays.

Short Belfast aircraft will be used to operate the service. "These aircraft are capable of accommodating the cargo pallets used on KLM Cargo's intercontinental combi and freighter aircraft fleet," the airline stated.

The airline plans to reschedule many of its airfreight services due for introduction today (Feb 3), it stated. "The new schedules will enable KLM Cargo to meet producers logisitic requirements more closely, resulting in faster shipment times to consumers," stated the airline. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
